subject.title: fix(agents): classify Anthropic invalid_request_error as format for failover

question: Should structured invalid-request bodies and returned format-error payloads follow the same broad fallback semantics as existing HTTP 400/422 format failures?
rationale: The patch correctly closes a representation gap, but the resulting behavior can try another configured model for both model-specific incompatibilities and deterministic request defects, so the compatibility policy needs an owner decision.

options.title: Align all representations
options.body: Accept the intentional compatibility behavior so equivalent status-prefixed, structured-body, and returned-payload failures all use the shared format fallback policy.

options.title: Narrow fallback eligibility
options.body: Restrict structured invalid-request fallback to known model- or transcript-specific cases and keep other request defects terminal.

recommendation.title: Align all representations
recommendation.body: Accept the intentional compatibility behavior so equivalent status-prefixed, structured-body, and returned-payload failures all use the shared format fallback policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The commit history most strongly connects this person to the shared terminal classifier and returned-result fallback architecture where the policy lives.
